restaurantName: Liang Jie Nanning Pumiao Shengzha Mifen (Yinghua Street)
address: 242 Yinghua Street, Xiaogang Bay, Haizhu, Guangzhou, China Mainland
bio: This friendly neighbourhood shop specialises in sourdough rice noodles. While preserving her hometown culinary tradition, the owner also dials down the sourness to cater to local tastes. Noodles are made to order – fermented rice batter is squeezed into boiling water and then drenched in soup, or tossed with pickled string beans, ground pork and deep-fried tofu. You can also opt for the beef brisket version. Prepare to wait after placing orders....
